request.task: Create one complete proposed Tower Defense starter Unit from a faithful subset of the supplied character attack evidence. Use one readable base attack and three distinct paths with all fifteen upgrades. Plan a recognizable character repertoire and three meaningful purchasing choices before compiling numerical upgrades. Do not copy a complete generic arrangement from one compatible attack. Preserve source and story-period limits, omit unsupported powers, and label numerical mechanics and prices as proposed. Do not claim canon verification or balance.

character.name: Dart Monkey
character.scope: BTD6 patch 56.3 (Steam build 24829026) as captured by btd6-atlas at revision a380413. Supplied brief only; no other research.

documents.text:
Dart Monkey is a primary tower. Placement costs 200 at Medium. Its base attack throws one dart every 0.95 seconds at range 32; each dart deals 1 sharp damage and can hit 2 bloons. It cannot target Camo bloons, and its sharp darts cannot damage Lead or Frozen bloons.

Top path. Sharp Shots (140) raises dart pierce to 3. Razor Sharp Shots (200) raises it to 5. Spike-o-pult (320) replaces the dart with a spiked ball thrown every 1.15 seconds at range 36.8 that deals 2 damage, hits up to 18 bloons, rebounds off obstacles and can damage Frozen bloons. Juggernaut (1800) throws every second, raises pierce to 60, damages Lead, adds 3 damage against Ceramic and 2 against Fortified bloons and knocks light bloons back. Ultra-Juggernaut (15000) deals 5 damage with pierce 210 and larger Ceramic, Fortified and Lead bonuses; when its pierce runs out it splits into two rings of six smaller balls that each deal 2 damage with pierce 50.

Middle path. Quick Shots (100) shortens the attack interval to 0.8075 seconds. Very Quick Shots (190) shortens it to 0.6365 seconds. Triple Shot (450) throws three darts in a 30 degree arc every 0.477 seconds. Super Monkey Fan Club (7200) halves the interval again and adds an activated ability: for 15 seconds, up to 10 nearby Dart Monkeys with no path above tier 2 become super monkeys that attack about 16 times as often; the ability recharges in 50 seconds. Plasma Monkey Fan Club (45000) keeps that timing, affects up to 20 Dart Monkeys, and their plasma darts gain 1 damage and 3 pierce.

Bottom path. Long Range Darts (90) extends range to 40. Enhanced Eyesight (200) extends range to 48 and lets this Dart Monkey target Camo bloons. Crossbow (575) fires bolts that deal 3 damage with pierce 4 at range 60. Sharp Shooter (2050) deals 6 damage every 0.475 seconds, and every tenth shot is a critical hit for 50 damage. Crossbow Master (21500) deals 8 damage every 0.2375 seconds with pierce 8 at range 80, can damage every bloon type, and every fifth shot is a critical hit for 80 damage.

documents.text:
Experimental BTD6-inspired Tower Defense profile, version 11. Editable starter rules, not Manga Mayhem rules or balance certification. The structured mechanicsDefinition owns executable operators, numerical limits and the starter scale; supplied progression references illustrate that scale, not fixed character kits.

Generation makes two model calls: first a compact source-backed purchase-plan-v1 contract, then numerical mechanics. The model chooses a recognizable base, three purchasing situations, retained weaknesses and capstone reasons, with one description and typed intent per milestone. Code binds evidence, generates crosspath bookkeeping, resolves costs and arithmetic, checks plan feasibility and every legal build, and reports analytical purchase comparisons. Revisions use the same route.

Adapt a coherent subset of the supplied character evidence. Respect ownership, prerequisites, story period and source limitations. Reserve or omit unsupported techniques explicitly. Names reflect purchased behavior; citations and names do not prove executable mechanics. One compatible attack must not select an entire generic kit.

A stationary Unit attacks detected enemies in range with a clear delivery path. Detection does not grant delivery access. Use one readable automatic base attack; no manual activation at base. Use Gold for match currency and Health for the shared player life pool, initially 150 Health. Units have no Health or durability. The basic enemy reference has one layer removed by 1 damage. Tough enemies need explicit rules; no enemy layer tree or leak simulation is implemented.

Three paths each have five sequential upgrades. Buy at most two paths, only one above T2. A 3-0-0 build can still buy 3-1-0 then 3-2-0; 3-3-0 and 3-2-1 are illegal. Purchased upgrades stack. T1/T2 preserve the existing attack identity: improve damage, cadence, range, pierce or existing statuses, with personal detection allowed. They introduce no new status, secondary attack, delivery, damage-type access, targeting or multi-shot pattern. Early effect and capability limits come from the Definition and are ceilings, not quotas.

T3 establishes a narrower specialization. T4 develops it and T5 culminates it. Focused numerical development is valid; no new effect, new subsystem or universal threefold multiplier is mandatory. Broad role labels may repeat when actual timing, coverage, target use or investment purpose differs. First purchases and capstones must differ mechanically, not merely by name or price. Preserve meaningful weaknesses and useful early crosspath contributions without granting unpurchased advanced powers.

The default permits an optional manual boost only on path2, first at T4; T5 may develop that same boost. Paths 1 and 3 remain automatic, and path2 may also remain automatic. Boosts affect the purchased attack, not an independent actor. Manual activation and cooldowns belong to the placed Unit; attack cadence is distinct from ability recharge. An explicit custom Definition can change the permitted slot.

Explain why a player concentrates Gold in T5 instead of buying lower-tier copies. Compare supported capacity, reach, access, timing and retained limitations without declaring a universal winner. T5 uniqueness allows one placed T5 per player, Unit type and path at a time, with different paths on separate copies. The caller enforces uniqueness from match state.

Every purchase must implement its declared benefit in all legal builds, including secondary purchases after specialization. Code reports before/after values and target limits; prose cannot add hidden effects. Setters must not erase a purchased crosspath benefit. Review the base, pure advanced paths, early two-path builds and legal T5 crosspaths. Analytical capacities and equal-budget comparisons do not simulate waves, geometry, placement pressure, player decisions or balance.

The current Definition supports one base attack, supported delivery and status effects, temporary self boosts, distinct-target volleys and bounded follow-ups. Follow-ups are secondary hits with explicit inheritance, not wall bounces, recursive attacks or independent actors. Allied buffs, summons, independent attacks, economy, movement and other unsupported behavior remain unapproved extension proposals. Reference towers grant no unsupported operators. The Definition's vocabulary names its status effects, damage types, targeting and detection traits; each status effect declares its kind, bounds, duration limit, stacking and immunities, and no other effect exists.

Reference provenance: user-supplied btd6_towers.json, compiled September 20, 2026, SHA256 a2a5e2bb4591a6278f079a6796d06f76428716080bd4a42453f898cb1403f8f6. Base stats cite https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Btd6ModHelper/btd6-game-data/main/Towers/DartMonkey/DartMonkey.json and the corresponding BoomerangMonkey file; Medium prices cite https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hemisemidemipresent/cyberquincy/master/jsons/costs.json. The dataset combines unpinned patches. Missing timings are unknown, not zero. Health and layer references are starter assumptions. Values and prices remain proposed and need playtesting.

constraints.text: Camo detection arrives only through Enhanced Eyesight on the bottom path and applies to this Unit alone. There is no allied revealing.
Lead damage arrives only through Juggernaut on the top path or Crossbow Master on the bottom path. Attack speed and range purchases do not grant it.
The Fan Club ability transforms other nearby Dart Monkeys. Only this Unit's own share of the ability may be modeled as a manual boost; the allied transformation stays an unsupported mechanic.

character.name: Dart Monkey
character.scope: BTD6 patch 56.3 (Steam build 24829026) as captured by btd6-atlas at revision a380413. Supplied brief only; no other research.

candidate.role: Multiple-target projectile attacker. Requires a clear delivery path. Starts without Camo detection. Base damage cannot affect Lead, Frozen enemies.

basicAttack.name: Thrown Dart
basicAttack.behavior: Placement: 200 Gold. 1 damage every 0.95 s; 32 map-unit range; 1 projectile(s) per attack aimed at the selected primary target; 2 target(s) per projectile, including primary and splash targets.
basicAttack.delivery: projectile; Sharp damage; clear delivery path required.
basicAttack.limitations: Numeric values are proposed on the supplied starter scale. No Unit HP. Runtime integration and balance testing remain required.

paths.name: Spiked Ball Thrower
paths.theme: Higher damage per hit, secondary hits on nearby enemies, wider coverage, longer reach, normal damage. Tradeoffs: slower attacks.

tiers.name: Spike-o-pult
tiers.benefit: 360 Gold. damage 1 to 2 (+1); pierce (targets) 5 to 18 (+13); range (map units) 32 to 36.8 (+4.8); attack interval (s) 0.95 to 1.15 (+0.2).

tiers.name: Juggernaut
tiers.benefit: 1900 Gold. attack interval (s) 1.15 to 1 (-0.15); pierce (targets) 18 to 60 (+42); damageType sharp to normal.

tiers.name: Ultra-Juggernaut
tiers.benefit: 16000 Gold. damage 2 to 5 (+3); pierce (targets) 60 to 210 (+150); Ultra-Juggernaut Fragments: after a primary volley hits, strike up to 12 other detected enemies within 20 map units of the primary impact, nearest first, once each for 0.4x the purchased hit damage. Excludes every enemy hit by the primary volley. No inherited status effects. Same damage type and clear-path requirement; no inherited splash, pierce, additional volleys or recursive follow-ups.

paths.name: Quick Shots and Fan Club
paths.theme: Faster attacks, volleys across distinct targets, a manual attack boost.

tiers.name: Triple Shot
tiers.benefit: 400 Gold. projectiles per attack 1 to 3 (+2); attack interval (s) 0.6379 to 0.4784 (multiply by 0.75); Volley now targets distinct detected enemies in range, primary first then nearest to the primary; one projectile per target, unused shots are lost.

tiers.name: Super Monkey Fan Club
tiers.benefit: 2400 Gold. attack interval (s) 0.4784 to 0.2392 (multiply by 0.5); Unlock Fan Club Rapid Fire.

paths.name: Long Range Crossbow
paths.theme: Higher damage per hit, faster attacks, wider coverage, longer reach, Camo detection, normal damage.

tiers.name: Enhanced Eyesight
tiers.benefit: 230 Gold. range (map units) 40 to 48 (+8); Detect Camo enemies; delivery still requires a clear path.

tiers.name: Crossbow
tiers.benefit: 420 Gold. damage 1 to 3 (+2); pierce (targets) 2 to 4 (+2); range (map units) 48 to 60 (+12).

tiers.name: Sharp Shooter
tiers.benefit: 2000 Gold. damage 3 to 6 (+3); attack interval (s) 0.95 to 0.475 (multiply by 0.5).

tiers.name: Crossbow Master
tiers.benefit: 14000 Gold. attack interval (s) 0.475 to 0.2375 (multiply by 0.5); pierce (targets) 4 to 8 (+4); range (map units) 60 to 80 (+20); damageType sharp to normal.

abilities.name: Fan Club Rapid Fire
abilities.description: At tier 4: For 15 s, multiply the purchased attack's damage by 1 and its interval by 0.25, and add 0 range. Cooldown: 50 s from activation. Ready on purchase; cannot reactivate while active. Later upgrades modify the fields stated in their tier benefits.
abilities.availability: Quick Shots and Fan Club, tier 4. Manual activation.
abilities.delivery: Modifies this Unit's purchased base attack.
abilities.limitations: No independent attack, extra actor, obstruction bypass or unpurchased upgrade is granted.

abilities.name: Spiked ball rebounds off obstacles
abilities.description: Every delivery needs a clear path and the Definition has no rebound or wall interaction, so the Spike-o-pult, Juggernaut and Ultra-Juggernaut balls do not bounce.
abilities.limitations: Reserved for a later definition or design revision.

abilities.name: Spike-o-pult Frozen damage
abilities.description: No damage type here damages Frozen without also damaging Lead, and Lead access is reserved for Juggernaut and Crossbow Master, so the Tier3 ball stays sharp.
abilities.limitations: Reserved for a later definition or design revision.

abilities.name: Juggernaut and Ultra-Juggernaut Ceramic, Fortified and Lead bonuses
abilities.description: The vocabulary has no Ceramic or Fortified property and no class damage bonus; the bonuses are omitted rather than folded into ordinary damage, and only Lead access is modeled.
abilities.limitations: Reserved for a later definition or design revision.

abilities.name: Juggernaut knockback
abilities.description: Knockback is not a status effect in this Definition and is not renamed as slow or stun.
abilities.limitations: Reserved for a later definition or design revision.

abilities.name: Ultra-Juggernaut split trigger and rings
abilities.description: The split when pierce runs out, the two rings of six balls with pierce 50 and child rebounds are approximated only by a 12 target follow-up after the primary hit.
abilities.limitations: Reserved for a later definition or design revision.

abilities.name: Triple Shot 30 degree arc
abilities.description: Spread geometry is not modeled; the three darts use the distinct volley rule instead.
abilities.limitations: Reserved for a later definition or design revision.

abilities.name: Fan Club allied transformation
abilities.description: Turning up to 10 or 20 nearby Dart Monkeys into super or plasma monkeys is an allied effect; only this Unit's own boost is modeled.
abilities.limitations: Reserved for a later definition or design revision.

abilities.name: Plasma dart extra pierce
abilities.description: Boost fields cover damage, interval, range, duration and cooldown but not pierce, so only extra damage in the window is modeled.
abilities.limitations: Reserved for a later definition or design revision.

abilities.name: Sharp Shooter and Crossbow Master critical hits
abilities.description: Shot count critical hits need a counter the Definition lacks; they are omitted rather than converted into ordinary damage.
abilities.limitations: Reserved for a later definition or design revision.

abilities.name: Crossbow Master damage increase
abilities.description: The Tier5 four change budget is spent on interval, pierce, range and damage type, so bolt damage stays at the Sharp Shooter value of 6.
abilities.limitations: Reserved for a later definition or design revision.

mechanics.name: Attack and upgrade composition
mechanics.behavior: Only purchased upgrades apply. Set operations replace the baseline; all additions then multipliers compose in canonical order. Detection and clear delivery are separate. Immunities and effect stacking follow the supplied definition. Upgrade before/after examples show the main path alone; crosspaths compose over the same base. All values are proposals.

mechanics.name: Manual attack boost
mechanics.behavior: Ready on purchase; cooldown starts at activation. No reactivation while active. The boost applies to the purchased attack and expires without erasing its upgrades.

mechanics.name: Allied Dart Monkey transformation
mechanics.behavior: Fan Club transforms other nearby Dart Monkeys; the Definition has no allied buff or transformation operator, so only this Unit's own manual boost is modeled.
mechanics.requiredDecision: Specify and approve a definition extension before including this behavior in a build.

mechanics.name: Shot count critical hits
mechanics.behavior: Sharp Shooter and Crossbow Master deal periodic critical hits every tenth or fifth shot; there is no shot counter or critical damage field.
mechanics.requiredDecision: Specify and approve a definition extension before including this behavior in a build.

mechanics.name: Pierce exhaustion split trigger
mechanics.behavior: Ultra-Juggernaut splits into two rings of six balls when its pierce runs out; follow-ups trigger after the primary hit and have no ring geometry or own pierce.
mechanics.requiredDecision: Specify and approve a definition extension before including this behavior in a build.

mechanics.name: Obstacle rebound trajectory
mechanics.behavior: Spiked balls rebound off obstacles in the source; all deliveries here need a clear path and no bounce operator exists.
mechanics.requiredDecision: Specify and approve a definition extension before including this behavior in a build.

mechanics.name: Enemy class damage bonus and knockback
mechanics.behavior: Juggernaut's Ceramic, Fortified and Lead bonuses and its knockback need enemy class bonuses and a displacement effect that the Definition lacks.
mechanics.requiredDecision: Specify and approve a definition extension before including this behavior in a build.

mechanics.name: Boost pierce modifier
mechanics.behavior: Plasma darts gain 3 pierce during Fan Club; manual boosts cannot change pierce.
mechanics.requiredDecision: Specify and approve a definition extension before including this behavior in a build.

The transformation of other nearby Dart Monkeys is listed in unsupportedMechanics and grants no build behavior.

findings.subject: candidate
findings.message: Typed checks resolve every legal upgrade build and verify the compiled candidate. Deterministic checks cover references, assignments, dependencies and supplied progression constraints. They do not execute gameplay, establish semantic decision preservation, determine combat balance or grant acceptance.

findings.subject: Base attack targeting, inherited by all paths
findings.rule: Plan prose must not promise behavior absent from the compiled attack.
findings.message: The designPlan says the dart, spiked ball, bolt and Triple Shot aim at the player's chosen target or targeting priority. The compiled base attack lists only First targeting, and neither the Definition nor the profile says the player can switch among First, Last, Close and Strong. If targeting is fixed at First, path3 cannot focus a durable priority enemy behind a stream, and the path2 boost cannot be aimed at the dangerous enemy in a push. Both jobs the plan assigns become weaker.
findings.action: Decide whether the player can select the targeting priority from the Definition's four options, with First as the default, and state that in the base attack. Otherwise replace 'the player's chosen target' in the plan with 'the First enemy'.

findings.subject: Path2 T3 Triple Shot
findings.rule: Retained plan text must match the resolved volley mechanics.
findings.message: The compiled Triple Shot sends its three darts to distinct enemies, primary first and then nearest, and loses unused darts. reserved-6 says the same. The plan's omittedTechniques entry for the 30 degree arc says the opposite: all darts of a volley aim at the same primary target. The T3 milestone also opens with that wording. The difference matters because a lone durable enemy receives only one dart per volley. Path2's direct damage rate therefore equals its attack rate (4.18 at T4), and against a single target Triple Shot adds only its 0.75 interval multiplier. The path2 weakness does not mention this.
findings.action: Rewrite the omittedTechniques reason and the T3 milestone to say the darts go to distinct enemies and a lone target receives one dart per volley. Add that limit to the path2 weakness.

findings.subject: Path2 T5 Plasma Monkey Fan Club
findings.rule: T5 must give a coherent reason to concentrate Gold instead of buying T4 copies.
findings.message: Plasma Monkey Fan Club spends 8500 Gold on one change: the boost damage multiplier rises from 1 to 2. Sustained direct and group rates stay at 4.18 and 25.08, so outside the 15 s window in every 50 s the T5 is identical to the T4. The reference ordinary enemy is removed by 1 damage, so doubled darts remove no extra ordinary enemies even inside the window. The same budget buys three T4 copies with a sustained direct rate of 12.54 and three boost windows. The capstoneValue argues 'more per hit', but this Definition has no armor or per-hit threshold that rewards it, so the case for concentrating Gold rests on a single placement's burst against durable enemies. This is a numerical concern, not a proven contradiction.
findings.action: Choose the T5 purchase reason. Either approve proposal-6 so the window also gains the source's plasma pierce, which would help against streams too, or state in capstoneValue that T5 only doubles one placement's burst against durable enemies and recheck the 8500 Gold increment against three T4 copies.

findings.subject: Path2 T4 Fan Club Rapid Fire
findings.rule: Source claims must concern this character and be supported by the cited passage.
findings.message: The fan-club-scope constraint permits modeling only a self boost, and the allied transformation is correctly reserved as proposal-1. However, the cited passage makes nearby Dart Monkeys with no path above tier 2 into super monkeys. A tier 4 path2 Unit does not meet that condition, and the passage states no effect on the Fan Club monkey itself. The repertoire entry presents the self boost as a subset of the source ability when it is actually an adaptation authorized by the caller.
findings.action: State in the repertoire limitation and in the ability limitations that the fan-club-scope constraint authorizes the self boost and that the supplied passage does not describe it.

findings.subject: Confirmed constraints and source period
findings.rule: Confirmed constraints must be semantically preserved in every legal build.
findings.message: personal-detection: Camo appears only at path3 T2 and applies only to this Unit's attack. lead-permission: the normal damage type appears only at path1 T4 and path3 T5, and Spike-o-pult correctly stays sharp because every non-sharp type in the vocabulary also damages Lead. fan-club-scope: the Unit builds only a self boost, and the allied transformation remains a proposed extension. All 19 passages concern the Dart Monkey at patch 56.3.

reviewSummary: The Dart Monkey Unit adapts the 19 supplied btd6-atlas 56.3 passages closely: the base dart, the pierce line into Spike-o-pult, Juggernaut and Ultra-Juggernaut, Quick Shots into Fan Club, and Long Range into Crossbow Master follow the cited facts, and omitted source effects are declared as reserved or proposed. The three confirmed constraints hold. The paths have distinct jobs: path1 covers dense lines and gets early Lead access, path2 covers sparse streams and a timed self burst, and path3 covers reach, Camo and late Lead access. Remaining issues: the plan promises player-chosen targeting but the compiled attack lists only First, the plan contradicts itself on how Triple Shot distributes darts, and the path2 capstone adds only boost-window damage for 8500 Gold. This review does not certify balance or runtime behavior.

designPlan.concept: A stationary Dart Monkey throws one cheap sharp dart at a time and can specialize into heavy spiked balls for dense groups, faster three dart volleys with a timed self boost, or long range crossbow bolts with personal Camo detection. All numbers and prices are proposed and are not canon verified or balanced.

signature.name: Dart Throwing Monkey
signature.adaptation: The Unit keeps the Dart Monkey's stationary single dart throw as its readable base attack. Each path grows that throw along one source upgrade line: heavier spiked balls on path1, faster multi dart volleys with a self boost on path2, and longer range crossbow bolts on path3.

repertoire.name: Thrown dart
repertoire.limitation: The base dart is sharp, hits only a small number of enemies, cannot target Camo enemies and cannot damage Lead or Frozen enemies.

repertoire.name: Sharper darts
repertoire.limitation: Sharp Shots and Razor Sharp Shots only raise the dart's pierce; they add no damage, speed or damage type access.

repertoire.name: Spiked ball
repertoire.limitation: Rebounds off obstacles, the Spike-o-pult's Frozen access without Lead access, Juggernaut knockback and Ceramic and Fortified bonuses are outside this Definition; only damage, pierce, range, cadence and Juggernaut's Lead access are adapted.

repertoire.name: Splitting Ultra-Juggernaut
repertoire.limitation: The split when pierce runs out and the two rings of six balls are adapted only as a bounded follow-up on distinct secondary enemies; ring geometry, child rebounds and larger class bonuses are omitted.

repertoire.name: Quick Shots and Triple Shot
repertoire.limitation: Faster throwing and a three dart volley are adapted; the 30 degree arc is not modeled as spread geometry.

repertoire.name: Monkey Fan Club ability
repertoire.limitation: The source ability transforms other nearby Dart Monkeys; only this Unit's own faster attack and extra dart damage during the window are modeled, and the allied transformation and plasma pierce are omitted.

repertoire.name: Long range and Enhanced Eyesight
repertoire.limitation: Range and Camo detection apply to this Dart Monkey alone; there is no allied revealing.

repertoire.name: Crossbow line
repertoire.limitation: Bolt damage, cadence, pierce, range and Crossbow Master's all type damage access are adapted; the shot count critical hits of Sharp Shooter and Crossbow Master are omitted.

base.name: Thrown Dart
base.behavior: On each attack the Unit throws one sharp dart at the enemy chosen by the player's targeting priority within its short range. The dart deals low damage and can hit a small number of enemies before it is used up. The base attack cannot target Camo enemies, cannot damage Lead or Frozen enemies and needs a clear path to its target. There is no manual activation at base.

path1.name: Spiked Ball Thrower
path1.buyFor: Dense groups of enemies that pass through one clear throwing line, including Lead and Frozen enemies once Juggernaut is bought.
path1.weakness: Each attack is still one ball aimed at one primary target, so an isolated enemy leaves most of its pierce unused. Until Juggernaut the ball stays sharp and cannot damage Lead or Frozen enemies. The path never detects Camo enemies unless Enhanced Eyesight is bought as a crosspath. Rebounds are not modeled, so the ball needs a clear path, and its cadence stays slower than the path2 volleys. The Ultra-Juggernaut fragments reach only secondary enemies near the primary target and never add hits on the primary.

milestones.tier1: Sharp Shots raises the pierce of each thrown dart so one dart can hit more enemies before it is used up. Damage, cadence, range and targeting stay the same.
milestones.tier2: Razor Sharp Shots raises each dart's pierce again, stacking with Sharp Shots. The attack is still one sharp dart aimed at the player's chosen target.
milestones.tier3: Spike-o-pult replaces the dart with one spiked ball aimed at the player's chosen target, with more damage, much larger pierce and slightly longer range, thrown on a slower cadence than the dart as in the source. The ball still deals sharp damage, and earlier pierce purchases plus any crosspath speed, range or Camo purchases continue to apply to it. The ball does not rebound off obstacles and needs a clear path like every delivery.
milestones.tier4: Juggernaut throws the spiked ball more often, raises its pierce greatly and changes its damage type from sharp to normal so it can damage Lead and Frozen enemies. Damage per hit, targeting and the single ball per attack are unchanged. The source's Ceramic and Fortified bonuses and knockback of light enemies are not modeled.
milestones.tier5: Ultra-Juggernaut raises the parent ball's damage and pierce and adds a follow-up of smaller normal damage fragments each time the ball strikes its primary target. The fragments hit a bounded number of distinct eligible secondary enemies near that target, never the primary target again, and use their own hit capacity instead of refilling the parent's pierce; crosspath range does not enlarge their radius. This adapts the source split, which happens when pierce runs out, without ring geometry, rebounds or larger Ceramic, Fortified and Lead bonuses.

path1.capstoneValue: One Ultra-Juggernaut concentrates a very large pierce budget, higher damage per hit and a follow-up of fragments in a single throwing position, so one placement covers a dense group that several Juggernauts would need separate positions and clear lines to reach. The fragments add hits on secondary enemies around each primary target without drawing on the parent ball's pierce. Several T4 copies still attack more often in total and can cover different lanes, so the capstone favors one crowded corridor over spread out threats.

crosspaths.contribution: Proposed early purchases: Quick Shots shortens the interval between dart throws. Damage, pierce, range and targeting are unchanged. Very Quick Shots shortens the interval again, stacking with Quick Shots, while the attack remains one sharp dart per throw.

Proposed early purchases: Long Range Darts extends the dart's range. Damage, pierce, cadence and targeting are unchanged. Enhanced Eyesight extends range again and lets this Unit's own attack detect and target Camo enemies. No other Unit gains detection.

path1.referenceExample: BTD6 progression and tradeoffs inform this proposal; the supplied Definition alone authorizes mechanics.

path2.name: Quick Shots and Fan Club
path2.buyFor: Steady streams of enemies that need many hits over time, and planned dangerous pushes where the player can time a burst window while enemies are inside range.
path2.weakness: Darts stay sharp on every tier, and because path2 is the advanced path, Juggernaut and Crossbow Master cannot be bought beside it, so this path never damages Lead or Frozen enemies. Camo detection needs Enhanced Eyesight from path3, and range stays short unless path3 range is bought. The boost helps only while enemies are inside range during its window and then waits for its recharge. The allied transformation is not modeled, so the Unit cannot empower other Dart Monkeys.

milestones.tier1: Quick Shots shortens the interval between dart throws. Damage, pierce, range and targeting are unchanged.
milestones.tier2: Very Quick Shots shortens the interval again, stacking with Quick Shots, while the attack remains one sharp dart per throw.
milestones.tier3: Triple Shot replaces the single dart with a volley of three darts per attack, all aimed at the player's chosen primary target, and shortens the interval again. Each dart inherits the current damage, pierce, range and detection, including crosspath pierce, range or Camo purchases, and carries its own pierce; under the distinct volley rule the darts of one volley hit distinct enemies instead of stacking hits on one enemy. The source's 30 degree arc is not modeled as spread geometry.
milestones.tier4: Super Monkey Fan Club halves the ordinary interval again and adds a manual boost for this Unit only: while active, the three dart volley fires much faster for a fixed window, then the attack returns to the ordinary rate and the boost recharges. The boost is ready on purchase, its cooldown starts on activation, it cannot be reactivated while active, and ordinary attack speed does not shorten the cooldown. The source's transformation of other nearby Dart Monkeys into super monkeys is not modeled.
milestones.tier5: Plasma Monkey Fan Club keeps the ordinary interval, boost window, boosted rate and recharge from Super Monkey Fan Club and adds extra damage to every dart this Unit throws while the boost is active. The ordinary attack outside the window is unchanged, and the darts remain sharp in both states. The source's extra plasma pierce, the larger count of affected Dart Monkeys and every allied effect are not modeled.

path2.capstoneValue: One Plasma Monkey Fan Club keeps the fast ordinary three dart volley and adds damage to every dart during its boost window, so a single controlled burst deals more per hit than the burst of a T4 copy. Several T4 copies can stagger their own windows and cover more space, but each throws weaker darts during its boost and needs its own placement. The capstone favors one timed defense point against tougher waves, and it still cannot damage Lead or Frozen enemies.

crosspaths.contribution: Proposed early purchases: Sharp Shots raises the pierce of each thrown dart so one dart can hit more enemies before it is used up. Damage, cadence, range and targeting stay the same. Razor Sharp Shots raises each dart's pierce again, stacking with Sharp Shots. The attack is still one sharp dart aimed at the player's chosen target.

Proposed early purchases: Long Range Darts extends the dart's range. Damage, pierce, cadence and targeting are unchanged. Enhanced Eyesight extends range again and lets this Unit's own attack detect and target Camo enemies. No other Unit gains detection.

path2.referenceExample: BTD6 progression and tradeoffs inform this proposal; the supplied Definition alone authorizes mechanics.

path3.name: Long Range Crossbow
path3.buyFor: Long lanes and Camo enemies where one Unit must reach far along the track, and Lead or Frozen enemies once Crossbow Master is bought.
path3.weakness: Each attack is one bolt with modest pierce, so dense groups use up the bolt quickly compared with the spiked ball path. Until Crossbow Master the bolts stay sharp and cannot damage Lead or Frozen enemies. Camo detection helps only this Unit. Every bolt still needs a clear path, and the source's critical shots are not modeled, so damage against a single tough enemy comes only from ordinary bolt damage and cadence.

milestones.tier1: Long Range Darts extends the dart's range. Damage, pierce, cadence and targeting are unchanged.
milestones.tier2: Enhanced Eyesight extends range again and lets this Unit's own attack detect and target Camo enemies. No other Unit gains detection.
milestones.tier3: Crossbow replaces the dart with one crossbow bolt per attack that deals more damage, has more pierce and reaches much farther. The bolt still deals sharp damage and keeps personal Camo detection, and crosspath pierce or attack speed purchases continue to apply to it.
milestones.tier4: Sharp Shooter raises bolt damage and shortens the interval between bolts. The source's critical hit on every tenth shot is omitted rather than converted into extra ordinary damage.
milestones.tier5: Crossbow Master greatly shortens the interval between bolts, raises bolt pierce, extends range and changes the damage type from sharp to normal so bolts can damage Lead and Frozen enemies. Bolt damage stays at the Sharp Shooter level because this tier's four change budget is used by rate, pierce, range and damage type. The source's more frequent critical shot is not modeled.

path3.capstoneValue: One Crossbow Master fires much more often than a Sharp Shooter, raises bolt pierce, reaches farther and can damage Lead and Frozen enemies, so a single long range position answers resistant enemies that T4 copies cannot damage at all. Several Sharp Shooters add more bolts in total but need more placements with clear firing lines and still deal only sharp damage. The capstone keeps modest pierce per bolt, so dense groups remain better served by the spiked ball path.

crosspaths.contribution: Proposed early purchases: Sharp Shots raises the pierce of each thrown dart so one dart can hit more enemies before it is used up. Damage, cadence, range and targeting stay the same. Razor Sharp Shots raises each dart's pierce again, stacking with Sharp Shots. The attack is still one sharp dart aimed at the player's chosen target.

Proposed early purchases: Quick Shots shortens the interval between dart throws. Damage, pierce, range and targeting are unchanged. Very Quick Shots shortens the interval again, stacking with Quick Shots, while the attack remains one sharp dart per throw.

scopeLimits: All numbers, prices and balance are proposed and unplayed; this plan does not verify canon or balance.
Evidence is limited to the 19 supplied btd6-atlas passages for patch 56.3; selection is bounded, does not establish complete source coverage, and the attributed URL was not independently verified.
Camo detection comes only from Enhanced Eyesight on path3 and applies to this Unit alone; there is no allied revealing.

Lead damage comes only from Juggernaut on path1 and Crossbow Master on path3 through a change to the normal damage type, which also grants Frozen access; attack speed and range purchases never grant it.
Fan Club is modeled only as this Unit's own manual boost on path2; the transformation of other Dart Monkeys remains an unsupported allied mechanic.
Each Unit's path2 boost affects only its own attack; stacking or coordination between copies is unknown and no team effect is claimed.
The Ultra-Juggernaut follow-up occurs when the ball strikes its primary target rather than when its pierce runs out, which changes timing relative to the source.
No path applies slow, burn or stun, because no supplied passage describes those effects for the Dart Monkey.
Source placement and upgrade prices are historical references only and are not used as prices in this plan.
